note: Schema 1 recorded every non-PSX guest as mode 'native-bridge' against /dev/native0 guest kinds. That bridge does not exist in PowerEngine and has been removed; see the 'Removed: the native-bridge mock' section of docs/VIRTUA_PLATFORM.md. Each guest now reaches the device by one of two real routes, chosen by whether the guest CPU is the host CPU.

modes.static-recompilation: guest CPU is not ARMv7; guest code is translated to C ahead of time and compiled for Cortex-A7
modes.direct-execution: guest CPU is ARMv7, same as the host; guest instructions run untranslated and the guest's OS is reimplemented around them (the WINE model)

gba.note: Studio drives this automatically; the previous 'Native' checkbox and its /dev/native0 launcher are gone.

horizon.aarch64_note: refused by name; a Cortex-A7 cannot execute AArch64 at all
horizon.ipc: HIPC/CMIF transport complete; sm: implemented, no device services yet
horizon.svc_abi_32bit: derived from the AArch64 ABI, documented as D1/D2/D3 in extra/horizon2mvii/include/horizon_svc.h
